clips.title: The story
paras: At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek prepares young Horde warriors to defend those who cannot defend themselves. He sends them to Thunder Ridge to prove their endurance against its electric beasts.

At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek teaches young warriors that defense is part of the Horde's duty. The post lies on the border between the Barrens and Durotar. Uzzek says a warrior's highest calling is to stand between danger and those unable to defend themselves, taking the blows so the Horde can endure.

Uzzek sends the novices to Thunder Ridge, north across the Southfury River in Durotar, to test their stamina and resolve. Thunder lizards and lightning hides roam the canyon. The initiates must survive the beasts' jolts and harvest their singed scales to show they have the fortitude to hold the front line.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a warrior, one of our most crucial tasks is... Protection. We are the shield of the Horde, and we keep our weaker brethren safe. If you are to join in our ranks, then you must prove your mettle to me.

Go to Thunder Ridge in Durotar, where live the lightning hides and thunder lizards. Hunt the beasts! Show me you are tougher than they! Brave their assaults and bring me a stack of their singed scales as proof.
Do this, and then I will teach you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the scales, friend? Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah. I see you have defeated the thunder lizards, which proves you are tough. Now I will show you how tough skin and shrewd movements can combine to form an impenetrable wall of defense.
Learn your lesson well, friend. And be ready for future instruction.
